purpose: fixture skill catalog (6 skills, deliberate overlap) for SW-CM01 trigger evals

skills.name: postgres-operations
skills.description: PostgreSQL administration, SQL diagnostics, table/index sizing, query performance, vacuum, locks and database operations.

skills.name: kubernetes-operations
skills.description: Kubernetes workloads, pods, deployments, StatefulSets, Services, PVCs, events, kubectl diagnostics and cluster operations.

skills.name: kubernetes-postgres
skills.description: PostgreSQL running on Kubernetes, including StatefulSets, persistent volumes, failover and operator-managed database clusters.

skills.name: release-notes
skills.description: Generate release notes and changelogs from commits or pull requests.

skills.name: spreadsheet-analysis
skills.description: Analyze CSV/XLSX tabular data, statistics and spreadsheet transformations.

skills.name: aws-deployment
skills.description: Deploy or update applications and infrastructure on AWS.

design_notes: S1 (postgres-operations) and S3 (kubernetes-postgres) and S2 (kubernetes-operations) overlap intentionally: O01..O20 measure precision under description ambiguity.
Trigger surface in ClineMM is the SKILL NAME ONLY (definitions.ts:1027-1039 — only `name` is projected into the tool description; descriptions are loaded only after the model invokes the tool).
E005 tests the parse failure mode: typed slash command uses 'aws-deploy' but canonical name is 'aws-deployment'; the runtime must NOT find a match.
D001..D003 test enabled/disabled symmetry: when the skill is in the fixture catalog but disabled=true, it must NOT appear in the model's Available skills list and the tool must reject its invocation.
